items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Chick had a small group ... Chancy Horton and some of the other guys. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: See every time I see Ella I mean to ask her because she would know. But I was so impressed by this guy‟s playing. Chick had a small group called, I forget what he called them but they used to play in a Spanish town, the small band things, Chancy Horton and some of the other guys.
